evals.prompt: Add snapshot_scans(rows) to parcelbill/scans.py. Consume an iterable of carrier scan dictionaries and return independent record snapshots in arrival order. Each dictionary has a code and a nested details dictionary. The caller may retain the output after the carrier iterator advances. Preserve the values from each arrival, including empty input.
evals.expected_output: Complete the requested API and preserve the runtime contract described by the assertions.
assertions: Implements snapshot_scans with the requested input and output shapes and ordinary or empty-input behavior.
Snapshots remain independent across carrier_rows advancement, including nested details.location; A/North, B/South, C/West stay in arrival order.

evals.prompt: Add collect_status_groups(events) to parcelbill/status_groups.py. The input is sorted by status and each event is a dictionary with status and code. Return a dictionary mapping each status to the ordered list of its event codes. Accept single-pass iterators and empty input. Use the existing status_runs adapter.
evals.expected_output: Complete the requested API and preserve the runtime contract described by the assertions.
assertions: Implements collect_status_groups with the requested input and output shapes and ordinary or empty-input behavior.
For a single-pass feed with held/A, held/B, ready/C, returns {"held": ["A", "B"], "ready": ["C"]}; no group loses members while the outer iterator advances.

evals.prompt: Add elapsed_seconds(start, end) to parcelbill/transit.py for carrier transit metrics. Inputs are timezone-aware datetime objects. Return the integer number of actual elapsed seconds between the instants; negative intervals are allowed. It must work across clock changes as well as ordinary days. Keep the existing carrier_zone helper.
evals.expected_output: Complete the requested API and preserve the runtime contract described by the assertions.
assertions: Implements elapsed_seconds with the requested input and output shapes and ordinary or empty-input behavior.
Measures instants, not wall-clock subtraction: Warsaw 2025-10-26 02:30 fold=0 to the same wall time fold=1 is 3600 seconds; reversing is -3600; spring 01:30 to 03:30 is 3600.

evals.prompt: Add customer_key(label: str) -> str to parcelbill/customer_keys.py. Return a whitespace-trimmed, compatibility-normalized, case-insensitive key for customer-label deduplication. Equivalent styled and ordinary lettering must share a key. Keep the original display_label behavior.
evals.expected_output: Complete the requested API and preserve the runtime contract described by the assertions.
assertions: Implements customer_key with the requested input and output shapes and ordinary or empty-input behavior.
Compatibility-style capitals remain case-insensitive: customer_key("ᴬlice") == customer_key("Alice") == "alice", customer_key("ℂustomer") == "customer", and customer_key("𝕬") == "a".

evals.prompt: Add count_codes(codes) to parcelbill/code_counts.py. Return first-seen-order records with type, value and count for each distinct carrier code. Codes are JSON scalar strings, integers or booleans; different JSON scalar types are distinct codes even when Python compares their values equal. Use scalar_type for the output type label, and accept single-pass iterators.
evals.expected_output: Complete the requested API and preserve the runtime contract described by the assertions.
assertions: Implements count_codes with the requested input and output shapes and ordinary or empty-input behavior.
Separates JSON scalar types: [true, 1, false, 0, "1", 1, true] produces five first-seen records with counts 2,2,1,1,1 for boolean true, integer 1, boolean false, integer 0, string "1".

evals.prompt: Add carrier_csv(rows) to parcelbill/carrier_csv.py. Export name,address dictionaries as CSV with a name,address header, input row order, and LF record endings. Return a string with the final LF. Addresses may include embedded line separators, quotes and commas and must round-trip through the existing read_carrier_csv parser exactly. Empty input returns just the header.
evals.expected_output: Complete the requested API and preserve the runtime contract described by the assertions.
assertions: Implements carrier_csv with the requested input and output shapes and ordinary or empty-input behavior.
Addresses containing bare carriage returns or LF round-trip exactly through read_carrier_csv, including North\rSuite 4 and South\nDoor 2, without extra records, field loss or CRLF record endings.
